title: Nexus Auto Showcase 2024
challenge: Create an immersive, high-traffic stall that allows attendees to experience a new electric vehicle model in both physical and virtual space.
solution: We designed a multi-level stall featuring a revolving main stage for the vehicle, flanked by touch-interactive screens providing specs. A dedicated VR zone allowed users to test drive the car virtually. We used sleek, reflective materials to match the futuristic branding.

title: Horizon Cloud Technologies
challenge: Stand out at a massive tech summit with a limited footprint, while clearly communicating complex cloud architecture solutions.
solution: We went vertical, building a two-story structure with a striking LED mesh facade that displayed real-time data flows. The ground floor hosted quick meetings, while the upper deck served as a VIP presentation lounge.

title: BioHealth Innovators Expo
challenge: Design a clean, clinical, yet welcoming environment that facilitated private discussions while showcasing new medical equipment.
solution: We utilized a pristine white color palette with soft, organic curves inspired by cellular structures. Semi-private pods with frosted glass partitions allowed for confidential B2B meetings without feeling closed off from the event energy.

title: Urban Home Decor Fair
challenge: Simulate a luxury living room environment within a busy trade hall to showcase premium furniture collections.
solution: We constructed enclosed room sets with custom lighting rigs to mimic natural daylight. Hidden structural supports allowed for an open-plan feel while maintaining distinct functional zones for living, dining, and outdoor collections.
